name: scenario_0509
description: The user is researching historical documents from the 1960s and wants to extract and aggregate the names of the individuals involved across multiple memos and letters.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4]
Query: I am organizing my research on these historical documents. Please create a new note titled 'Document Senders' and list the names of the people who authored or sent each of these four documents.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a note titled 'Document Senders' and extract only the names of the people who authored or sent the four provided documents. If the assistant includes recipients or other mentioned individuals, correct it to only include the senders and signers. Once the note is successfully created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Actually, I realized that tracking just the senders won't be enough for my research project. I've changed my mind. Please update the note's title to 'All Mentioned Individuals' and replace the contents with a comprehensive, aggregated list of every single person's name mentioned, addressed, or signing across all four documents.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you have changed your mind and want to pivot your approach. Ask it to update the note's title to 'All Mentioned Individuals' and replace the text with a full list of every person named in the documents, including recipients and people mentioned in the body text or handwritten notes. If the assistant misses any names from the handwritten sections, point it back to the images to look closer. Once the note is updated with all the names, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3
Query: Now, please email this complete list of names to my co-researcher Dr. Evans, asking if he has any background information on their roles in the 1960s.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to email the full list of names from the updated note to Dr. Evans, asking if he has any background info on their roles in the 1960s. If the assistant asks for Dr. Evans's contact info, tell it to check your contacts. Once the email is successfully sent, you can end the conversation.

You have 4 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3

entity_data.subject: Background information on historical figures from the 1960s
entity_data.body:
Hi Dr. Evans,

I am organizing my research on some historical documents from the 1960s. Do you have any background information on the roles of the following people during that time?

- Alexander Heard
- Roland E. Schneckloth
- Dr. Krause
- Dr. Shank
- Bob
- Dick
- Dottie
- Miss Williamson
- Kathleen
- Dorothy
- Flo Feuerborn

Best,
Joyce
